statements.subject: message
statements.description: This argument SHOULD be in the format of an [RFC5322] or [I18N-HDRS] message.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A server implementation that is unable to preserve 8-bit data properly MUST be able to reversibly convert 8-bit APPEND data to 7 bits using a [MIME-IMB] content transfer encoding.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If a flag parenthesized list is specified, the flags SHOULD be set in the resulting message; otherwise, the flag list of the resulting message is set to "empty" by default.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If a date-time is specified, the internal date SHOULD be set in the resulting message; otherwise, the internal date of the resulting message is set to the current date and time by default.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the append is unsuccessful for any reason, the mailbox MUST be restored to its state before the APPEND attempt (other than possibly keeping the changed mailbox's UIDNEXT value); no partial appending is permitted.
actions: restore mailbox to its state before the APPEND attempt

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the destination mailbox does not exist, a server MUST return an error and MUST NOT automatically create the mailbox.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the destination mailbox does not exist, a server MUST return an error and MUST NOT automatically create the mailbox.
actions: do not automatically create the destination mailbox

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Unless it is certain that the destination mailbox cannot be created, the server MUST send the response code "[TRYCREATE]" as the prefix of the text of the tagged NO response.
actions: send [TRYCREATE] response code as prefix of tagged NO response text

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In the case of a mailbox that has permissions set so that the client can APPEND to the mailbox, but not SELECT or EXAMINE it, the server MUST NOT send an APPENDUID response code as it would disclose information about the mailbox.
statements.pre_cond: client.permission.APPEND = true & client.permission.SELECT = false & client.permission.EXAMINE = false
actions: omit APPENDUID response code from APPEND completion response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In the case of a mailbox that has UIDNOTSTICKY status (see Section 7.1), the server MAY omit the APPENDUID response code as it is not meaningful.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the mailbox is currently selected, normal new message actions SHOULD occur.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Specifically, the server SHOULD notify the client immediately via an untagged EXISTS response.
actions: send untagged EXISTS response to client immediately

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the server does not do so, the client MAY issue a NOOP command after one or more APPEND commands.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the server decides to convert (normalize) the mailbox name, it SHOULD return an untagged LIST with an OLDNAME extended data item, with the OLDNAME value being the supplied mailbox name and the name parameter being the normalized mailbox name.
actions: send untagged LIST with OLDNAME extended data item indicating original and normalized mailbox name
